reads.evidence: 46 technician and trades postings and 36 for drivers and logistics, level with 44 for engineers. Software and data is 5.
reads.quality: Carson's openings are hands-on, and many do not ask for a four-year degree.
reads.move: List the technician and warehouse openings with their pay once wages can be collected, so the good ones stand out.
reads.why: Title matching is blunt, and the feed undercounts small employers.

reads.evidence: About 74% of homes are owned by the people living in them, the highest share of the ten towns.
reads.quality: Residents are settled, so changes to work nearby matter more than in a town where people move often.
reads.move: Ask what would keep the next generation here: the homes are owned, but by whom, and for how long.
reads.why: One survey figure. It says nothing about age or who inherits.

gaps: Port and refinery hiring that runs through union halls and contractors.
Air quality next to the freight corridors.
